DESCRIPTION: General description  Bubble flowmeter is a simple and precise way to measure flow rates of gases.  It is the most common device for measuring a volumetric flow rate. This unit has a buret of appropriate volume fitted with rubber bulb at the bottom and a side arm. Air is passed into the buret and the bulb filled with soap solution is squeezed. DESCRIPTION: General description  Bubble flowmeter is a simple and precise way to measure flow rates of gases.  It is the most common device for measuring a volumetric flow rate. This unit has a buret of appropriate volume fitted with rubber bulb at the bottom and a side arm. Air is passed into the buret and the bulb filled with soap solution is squeezed.
